data.name: DESC_Info.Text
data.value: Claytonic is a comprehensive suite of tools designed to aid Helpdesk technicians and CSRs with their work. This software accesses unique locations on the network drive, eliminating the need for technicians to manually search for these tools. The goal of this application is to create a centralized place for tools.

data.name: patchNotes.Text
data.value:
• Optimized core program code significantly reducing application size from 15 MB to 4.6 MB, resulting in faster load times and improved update performance.
• Enhanced user interface by refining layout, improving text spacing, and removing outdated form controls.
• Resolved ghost mouse dragging issue, ensuring stable window movement upon application launch.
• Deprecated music functionality to streamline performance.
• Replaced NPC Fox with [new character name or description].
